I’ll read the design note, trace the relevant state transitions through the code, and report the cause and any uncertainty.

---
author: 
id: B_297
internalId: b09b6ef5-69c9-414f-bb05-e893f0e79d55
title: action ready state no longer detected
status: design
owner: 
affects:
agents:
  - design/activity/card__b09b6ef5-69c9-414f-bb05-e893f0e79d55.json
policy:
---
recent changes have broken the system: the renderer no longer seems to react when the agent is ready and is waiting for input. Maybe this message is no longer sent from desktop to renderer or maybe the action buttons (and run button) no longer monitor or receive the correct event?

we did change something recently to improve speed so that not all cards and / or action popups would monitor 'all changes' but only specific changes, maybe we forgot some?

entries.content:
The waiting-state path is wired through: desktop emits `waitingForInput`, the renderer stores it, and the run button and action selector subscribe to the resulting state. Existing tests confirm those buttons react when that event reaches them.

I could not establish the cause of the reported live failure from the code alone. One specific weakness is that the **Run** button displays the first active run for a context; if another run is still marked `running`, it can mask a waiting conversation on the same card. I did not verify that this is the case you encountered. No files were changed.
